security_findings.title: Missing HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS)
security_findings.detail: The server does not enforce HTTPS connections via HSTS header.
security_findings.remediation: Add 'Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains' to web server headers.

security_findings.remediation: Block public access to '/config.json' or remove this file immediately from web root.
